The main takeaway from our work is that
serum sodium level is a valid prognostic tool for patients with cirrhoses and end-stage liver disease, and it should be considered when assessing patients for liver transplantation.
the serum sodium level, when considered in combination to the MELD Score, is the most accurate tool for predicting survival in patients with liver cirrhosis awaiting liver transplant.
